_comment: Copy this to your project as config.json. Nothing personal belongs in the skill itself. Hebrew-first defaults; change language.code/direction for other languages.

language._comment_transcriber: auto = ivrit.ai Hebrew Whisper for 'he', large-v3 otherwise (free, local). 'scribe' = ElevenLabs, paid, needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.

grid._comment: reels = organic Instagram Reels (default). ads = Meta's stricter safe zone for paid placements.

brand._comment_fonts: Free fonts only — see `python3 scripts/fonts.py list --hebrew`. display_family is optional (headlines, outro).
brand._comment_logo: Give a logo and run scripts/brand_from_logo.py — it writes brand/brand.json + brand/brand.css, which recolour every card and highlight.

captions._comment: Default: 1-3 words, hard swap, white 62 px weight 500, soft shadow (style shadow). style plate = black on a white plate, for bright or busy footage. A card starts on its first word (lead 0), ends at the next card or the next hidden window, and is trimmed to last word + pause_tail when a pause longer than pause_trim follows. center_y is written by framing_map.py --apply (or apply_style.py from a reference), clamped to the grid.

style._comment: Filled by scripts/apply_style.py from an analysed reference video. Empty = house style.

outro._comment: Opt-in: only with a logo AND when the user asked for it. style: portal (signature) | line | impact.

matting._comment: Rotoscoping is optional and heavy (torch). Install with: python3 scripts/doctor.py --install --with-roto
